module Kv
  module User
    class UserRegistrationService < HttpService
      attr_accessor :response, :response_body

      def initialize(user:)
        @user = user
        @logging = true
      end

      def base_url
        ENV['KLOUDVILLE_ENDPOINT']
      end

      def headers
        {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'Authorization': "Bearer #{ENV['KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN']}"
        }
      end

      def relative_url
        '/service/omnichannel/customer/registerCustomer'
      end

      def api_method
        'POST'
      end

      def call
        self.fire!
      end

      def body
        {
          registerCustomer: {
            firstName: @user.name,
            lastName: @user.family_name,
            companyName: @user.business_name || @user.name,
            email: @user.email,
            phoneNr: generate_mobile_number,
            companyEmail: @user.business_email || @user.email,
            companyPhoneNr: generate_mobile_number
          }
        }.to_json
      end

      private
        # NOTE : Temporary for checking duplicate registration response code
        def email_duplicate?
          @response.status == 400
          @response_body[:message][:code] == "SCRIPT_ERR_0004"
          @response_body[:message][:text].include? "Multiple party roles found with email"
        end

        def generate_mobile_number
          prefix = "8111"
          random_six_digits = rand(1000000).to_s.rjust(6, '0')
          prefix + random_six_digits
        end
    end
  end
end

require 'jwt'

class KvToken
  def self.secret
    "#{ENV['KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN_SECRET']}"
  end

  def self.encode_token(email)
    payload = {
      sub: email,
      jti: SecureRandom.uuid,
      validFrom: nil,
      role: nil,
      realm: "Portal",
      ip: nil,
      uiToken: true,
      tokenType: "IOH",
      organization: nil,
      contactId: nil,
      # iat: Time.now.to_i,
      # exp: Time.now.to_i + 24 * 3600
    }

    token = JWT.encode(payload, secret, 'HS256')
    token
  end

  def self.decode_token(token)
    decoded = JWT.decode(token, secret, true, { algorithm: 'HS256' })
    decoded[0]
  rescue JWT::VerificationError, JWT::DecodeError, JWT::ExpiredSignature => e
    raise e
  end

  # Token Validation
  def self.validate_token(token)
    payload = decode_token(token)
    payload['sub']
  rescue JWT::VerificationError, JWT::DecodeError, JWT::ExpiredSignature => e
    raise e
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'auth0'

namespace :auth0 do
  task last_reset: :environment do
    @token = ""

    @auth0_client ||= Auth0Client.new(
      domain: ENV['AUTH0_DOMAIN'],
        token: @token,
        api_version: 2,
        timeout: 15
    )

    email = "kloudville.demo.ecommerce@gmail.com"

    user = @auth0_client.users_by_email(email).first
    backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)

    response = {}
    condition_did_reset = false
    condition_migrated_user = false
    condition_had_logged_in = false
    migration_date = Date.parse('2024-08-13') # hardcoded migration date

    # temp logging
    puts "==============AUTH0 USER================"
    puts user
    puts "=============================="

    puts "==============BACKYARD USER================"
    puts backyard_user
    puts "=============================="

    # condition 1
    if user['last_password_reset']
      condition_did_reset = true
    end
    response[:condition_did_reset] = condition_did_reset

    # condition 2
    if user['last_login']
      condition_had_logged_in = true
    end
    response[:condition_had_logged_in] = condition_had_logged_in

    # condition 3
    created_at = backyard_user.createdat
    if created_at < migration_date
      condition_migrated_user = true
      response[:condition_migrated_user] = condition_migrated_user
    end

    # verdict
    response[:need_reset] = !condition_did_reset && condition_migrated_user && !condition_had_logged_in ? true : false

    # temp logging
    puts "=========VERDICT====================="
    puts response
    puts "=============================="
  end
end

require 'csv'
require 'auth0'

namespace :users do
  task check_attachment: :environment do
    profile = UserProfile.find_by(email: 'kloudville.demo.ecommerce@gmail.com')

    if profile.ktp_document.attached?
      puts "Filename: #{profile.ktp_document.filename}"
      puts "Content Type: #{profile.ktp_document.content_type}"
      puts "File Size: #{profile.ktp_document.byte_size} bytes"

      File.open(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'downloaded_ktp.jpg'), 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(profile.ktp_document.download)
      end
      puts "Document downloaded to tmp/downloaded_ktp.jpg"
    else
      puts "No document attached"
    end
  end

  task check_attachment_link: :environment do
    profile = UserProfile.find_by(email: 'iksan.richard.dimas@gmail.com')

    puts "#{profile.ktp_document}"
    puts "#{profile.ktp_document_download_url}"
  end

  task check_auth0_profiles: :environment do
    # setup auth0
    token = ""
    auth0_client ||= Auth0Client.new(
      domain: ENV['AUTH0_DOMAIN'],
        token: token,
        api_version: 2,
        timeout: 15
    )

    CSV.foreach(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'ktp_initial_data.csv'), headers: true) do |row|
      email = row['email'].downcase

      auth0_user = auth0_client.users_by_email(email).first

      if auth0_user
        puts auth0_user['email']
      else
        puts "  cant find profile : #{email}"
      end
    end
  end

  task pre_migration_check: :environment do
    results = {
      flow1: [],
      flow2: [],
      flow3: [],
      flow4: []
    }
    total_processed = 0

    # setup auth0
    token = ""
    auth0_client ||= Auth0Client.new(
      domain: ENV['AUTH0_DOMAIN'],
      token: token,
      api_version: 2,
      timeout: 15
    )

    base_delay = 2 # initial delay in seconds

    CSV.foreach(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'ktp_initial_data.csv'), headers: true) do |row|
      email = row['email'].downcase

      begin
        auth0_user = auth0_client.users_by_email(email).first
        backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)
        user_profile = UserProfile.find_by(email: email)

        total_processed += 1

        if backyard_user && user_profile # flow 1: user and profile exists
          print("flow#1")
          results[:flow1] << { email: email }
        elsif backyard_user && !user_profile # flow 2: user exists but profile doesnt exists
          print("flow#2")
          results[:flow2] << { email: email }
        elsif !backyard_user && !user_profile # flow 3: user and profile doesn't exists
          print("flow#3")
          results[:flow3] << { email: email }
        else
          print(" unhandled flow#4") # flow4 : only user profile exists
          results[:flow4] << { email: email }
        end

        print " | email: #{email} |"
        print "  auth0_profile: #{auth0_user["user_id"] if auth0_user}"
        print "  backyard_user: #{backyard_user}"
        print "  user_profile: #{user_profile}\n"

      rescue Auth0::RateLimitEncountered => e
        # exponential backoff with jitter
        delay = base_delay + rand(1..1000) / 1000.0

        puts "\nRate limit encountered. Waiting #{delay} seconds before retrying..."
        sleep(delay)

        # increase the base delay for subsequent retries
        base_delay *= 2

        retry
      rescue => e
        puts "\nError processing email #{email}: #{e.message}"
        results[:flow4] << { email: email, error: e.message }
      end
    end

    # Print summary
    puts "\n\nProcess completed!"
    puts "Total rows processed: #{total_processed}"
    puts "Flow1: #{results[:flow1].count}"
    puts "Flow2: #{results[:flow2].count}"
    puts "Flow3: #{results[:flow3].count}"
    puts "Flow4: #{results[:flow4].count}"

    # print result
    File.open(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'pre_migration_results.json'), 'w') do |file|
      file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(results))
    end
  end

  task migrate_user_profile: :environment do
    results = {
      flow1: [],
      flow2: [],
      flow3: [],
      flow4: []
    }
    total_processed = 0

    # setup auth0
    token = ""
    auth0_client ||= Auth0Client.new(
      domain: ENV['AUTH0_DOMAIN'],
      token: token,
      api_version: 2,
      timeout: 15
    )

    base_delay = 2 # initial delay in seconds

    CSV.foreach(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'ktp_initial_data.csv'), headers: true) do |row|
      ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
        email = row['email'].downcase
        nik = row['NIK']
        kv_id = row['customerId']

        total_processed += 1
        puts "processing email: #{email}"

        begin
          auth0_user = auth0_client.users_by_email(email).first
        rescue Auth0::RateLimitEncountered => e
          delay = base_delay + rand(1..1000) / 1000.0

          puts "\nRate limit encountered. Waiting #{delay} seconds before retrying..."
          puts "  #{e.message}"
          sleep(delay)

          base_delay *= 2

          retry
        end

        backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)
        user_profile = UserProfile.find_by(email: email)

        puts "  backyard_user: #{backyard_user}"
        puts "  user_profile: #{user_profile}"

        if backyard_user && user_profile # flow 1: user and profile exists
          # update profile attributes
          user_profile.update!(
            nik: nik, # set nik
            user_id: backyard_user.id # set fk
          )

          # attach ktp document
          ktp_path = Dir.glob(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'ktp', "#{kv_id}_*")).first

          if ktp_path && File.exist?(ktp_path)
            begin
              user_profile.ktp_document.purge if user_profile.ktp_document.attached?

              # read the file contents into memory first
              file_contents = File.read(ktp_path)
              require 'stringio'
              file_io = StringIO.new(file_contents)

              user_profile.ktp_document.attach(
                io: file_io,
                filename: File.basename(ktp_path),
                content_type: 'image/jpeg'
              )

              puts "  [flow#1] Succeed added nik & ktp document for email #{email}"
              results[:flow1] << { email: email }
            rescue StandardError => e
              puts "  [flow#1] FAILED TO ATTACH DOCUMENT: #{email} - Error: #{e.message}"
              results[:flow4] << { email: email, error: e.message }
            end
          else
            puts "  [flow#1] FAILED TO GET DOCUMENT, NOT FOUND: #{email}"
            results[:flow4] << { email: email, error: 'Document not found' }
          end

        elsif backyard_user && !user_profile # flow 2: user exists but profile doesnt exists
          new_profile = UserProfile.create!(
            auth0_id: auth0_user['user_id'],
            kv_id: kv_id,
            email: email,
            name: auth0_user['name'],
            given_name: auth0_user['given_name'],
            family_name: auth0_user['family_name'],
            phone_number: backyard_user.contactno,
            country: backyard_user.country,
            province: backyard_user.province,
            city: backyard_user.city,
            district: backyard_user.district,
            address: backyard_user.address,
            postal_code: backyard_user.postalcode,
            business_email: backyard_user.email,
            business_contact: backyard_user.contactno,
            business_category: backyard_user.industry,
            source: backyard_user.source || "Register_Page",
            nik: nik,
            user_id: backyard_user.id
          )

          # attach ktp document
          ktp_path = Dir.glob(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'ktp', "#{kv_id}_*")).first

          if ktp_path && File.exist?(ktp_path)
            begin
              new_profile.ktp_document.purge if new_profile.ktp_document.attached?

              # read the file contents into memory first
              file_contents = File.read(ktp_path)
              require 'stringio'
              file_io = StringIO.new(file_contents)

              new_profile.ktp_document.attach(
                io: file_io,
                filename: File.basename(ktp_path),
                content_type: 'image/jpeg'
              )

              puts "  [flow#2] Succeed added nik & ktp document for email #{email}"
              results[:flow2] << { email: email }
            rescue StandardError => e
              puts "[flow#2] FAILED TO ATTACH DOCUMENT: #{email} - Error: #{e.message}"
              Rails.logger.error("[flow#2] FAILED TO ATTACH DOCUMENT: #{email} - Error: #{e.message}")
              results[:flow4] << { email: email, error: e.message }
            end
          else
            puts "  [flow#2] FAILED TO GET DOCUMENT FILE, NOT FOUND: #{email}"
            results[:flow4] << { email: email, error: 'Document not found' }
          end

        elsif !backyard_user && !user_profile # flow 3: user and profile doesn't exists
          puts "  [flow#3] email only exists in KV"
          results[:flow3] << { email: email }
        end

      rescue StandardError => e
        puts "  [general] Error processing row for #{row['email']}: #{e.message}"
        results[:flow4] << { email: row['email'], error: e.message }
      end
    end

    puts "\n\nProcess completed!"
    puts "Total rows processed: #{total_processed}"
    puts "Flow1: #{results[:flow1].count}"
    puts "Flow2: #{results[:flow2].count}"
    puts "Flow3: #{results[:flow3].count}"
    puts "Flow4: #{results[:flow4].count}"

    File.open(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'migrate_user_profile_results.json'), 'w') do |file|
      file.write(JSON.pretty_generate(results))
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Kv
  module User
    class NewUserSetupService
      def initialize(user:)
        @user = user
      end

      def call
        kv_id = register_kv_user
        grant_portal_access

        kv_id
      end

      private
        def register_kv_user
          user_registration_service = Kv::User::UserRegistrationService.new(user: @user)
          user_registration_service.call

          unless user_registration_service.success?
            raise KvRegistrationError.new(name: @user.name, email: @user.name, error_code: user_registration_service.response_body[:message][:code], message: "Failed to create new user on KV: #{user_registration_service.response_body[:message][:text]}")
          end

          kv_id = ''
          user_registration_service.response_body[:customer][:identifier].each do |identifier|
            if identifier[:primary] == true
              kv_id = identifier[:identifier]
            end
          end

          kv_id
        end

        def grant_portal_access
          grant_portal_access_service = Kv::User::GrantPortalAccessService.new(user: @user)
          grant_portal_access_service.call
        end
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'auth0'

module Api
  module V1
    class ProfilesController < ApiController
      before_action :authorize
      before_action :authorize_session_db
      before_action :decode_id_token, except: [:sync_document]
      before_action :account_is_active_check_from_id_token_hook, except: [:sync_document]

      def show
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)
        profile = user&.user_profile

        begin
          auth0_id = sub_from_id_token

          # find profile by auth0_id or email
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(auth0_id: auth0_id) if auth0_id
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(email: user.email) if profile.blank?
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          # add association if not exists
          profile.update!(backyard_user: user) if profile.backyard_user.blank?
          user.update!(user_profile: profile) if user.user_profile.blank?

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def update
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)

        begin
          profile = user.user_profile
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          if params[:ktp_document].present?
            profile.ktp_document.purge if profile.ktp_document.attached? # remove the old image if exists
            profile.ktp_document.attach(params[:ktp_document])
          end

          # only validate name fields if those fields are present in request
          profile.fields_to_validate = []
          [:name, :given_name, :family_name].each do |field|
            profile.fields_to_validate << field if params.key?(field.to_s)
          end

          profile.update!(profile_params)

          user.update!({
            fullname: profile_params['name'],
            contactno: profile_params['phone_number'],
            address: profile_params['address'],
            source: user.source # source cant be blank on update
          })

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          render json: { message: e.record.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def download_document
        user_id = params[:user_id]
        resource_id = params[:id]
        signature = params[:signature]
        expires_at = params[:expires_at].to_i

        # authorize
        attachment = ActiveStorage::Attachment.find(resource_id)
        profile = UserProfile.find(attachment.record_id)

        if profile.blank? || email_from_id_token != profile.email || profile.backyard_user.id != user_id
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        # validate the signed url
        unless LinkExpiration.valid_signed_url?(resource_id, signature, expires_at)
          return render json: { error: 'Invalid or expired download link' }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        # retrieve the blob
        blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find(attachment.blob_id)

        # serve the file
        send_data blob.download,
                  type: blob.content_type,
                  disposition: 'attachment',
                  filename: blob.filename.to_s
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
        render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
      end

      def sync_document
        kv_user_id = params[:user_id]
        email = sync_document_params[:email]
        resource_url = sync_document_params[:resource_url]

        filename = File.basename(resource_url)
        content_type = case File.extname(filename).downcase
                       when '.jpg', '.jpeg'
                         'image/jpeg'
                       when '.png'
                         'image/png'
                       when '.pdf'
                         'application/pdf'
                       else
                         'image/jpeg'
        end

        get_document_service = Kv::User::GetDocumentService.new(resource_url: resource_url)
        get_document_service.call

        response_body = get_document_service.response_body.b

        profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(kv_id: kv_user_id)
        profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(email: email) if profile.blank?
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, 'profile not found' if profile.blank?

        profile.ktp_document.attach(
          io: StringIO.new(response_body),
          filename: filename,
          content_type: content_type
        )

        profile.save!

        render json: { message: 'document sync successful' }, status: :ok
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
        render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
      end

      private
        def profile_params
          params.permit(:name, :given_name, :family_name, :phone_number, :gender, :address,
                        :birth_date, :mothers_name, :nik, :no_kk, :business_category,
                        :ktp_document)
        end

        def sync_document_params
          params.permit(:user_id, :email, :resource_url)
        end

        def email_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('email', nil)
        end

        def sub_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('sub', nil)
        end
    end
  end
end

          end

          # > check if account is deleted
          @debug_info[:step] = 'checking_account_active'
          account_is_active_check(email)

          # get user profile
          @debug_info[:step] = 'looking_up_backyard_user'
          backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)
          @debug_info[:backyard_user_found] = !backyard_user.nil?

          if backyard_user.nil?
            @debug_info[:error] = 'BackyardUser not found'
            render json: {
              message: 'User profile not found.'
            }, status: :not_found
          else
            @debug_info[:step] = 'success'
            @debug_info[:user_id] = backyard_user.id
            @debug_info[:user_type] = backyard_user.usertype

            # legacy data (if call this endpoint success, then this must be true)
            # might still be used by wawasan or landing
            user_session = true

            response_data = {
              message: 'User profile retrieved successfully.',
              data: {
                id: backyard_user.id,
                email: backyard_user.email,
                name: name,
                user_type: backyard_user.usertype,
                session: user_session
              }
            }

            render json: response_data
          end

        rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
          @debug_info[:error] = "JWT Decode Error: #{e.message}"
          render json: { message: 'Invalid JWT token.' }, status: :unauthorized
        rescue StandardError => e
          @debug_info[:error] = "#{e.class}: #{e.message}"
          @debug_info[:backtrace] = e.backtrace.first(3)
          render json: { message: 'Internal server error.' }, status: :internal_server_error
        end
      end

      def create
        # > check all flagging headers
        async_kv = request.headers['x-async-kv'] == 'true'

        result_auth0_id = nil  # store auth0 id, also used for rollback if KV failed

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          # > get sso app token
          @sso_token = Auth0TokenCache.get_token

          @auth0_user = User.new(auth0_user_params)
          @user_profile = UserProfile.new(create_user_profile_params)

          # > create backyard user
          @backyard_user = BackyardUser.new(
            id: ULID.generate,
            fullname: create_backyard_user_params[:name],
            email: create_backyard_user_params[:email],
            usertype: "basic",
            contactno: create_backyard_user_params[:phone_number],
            registrationType: "",
            industry: create_backyard_user_params[:business_category],
            bussinesscategory: create_backyard_user_params[:business_category],
            source: create_backyard_user_params[:source],
            isKV: 1,
          )

          @user_profile.backyard_user = @backyard_user
          @user_profile.save!
          @backyard_user.save!

          # > create auth0 user
          result_auth0_id = Auth0::CreateUserService.new(token: @sso_token, auth0_user: @auth0_user).call
          @user_profile.auth0_id = result_auth0_id
          @user_profile.save!

          # > create kv user
          unless async_kv
            kv_id = Kv::User::NewUserSetupService.new(user: @user_profile).call
            @user_profile.kv_id = kv_id
            @user_profile.save!
          end

          # > send auth0 verification email
          Auth0::Email::VerificationEmailService.new(token: @sso_token, auth0_id: result_auth0_id, client_id: ENV['AUTH0_LANDING_APP_CLIENT_ID']).call
        end

        KvRegisterJob.perform_later(user_id: @user_profile.id) if async_kv

        render json: {
          message: 'User created successfully.',
          data: @user_profile.as_json(except: [:backyard_user_id, :encrypted_nik, :encrypted_no_kk, :encrypted_mothers_name,
                                                  :encrypted_npwp, :ktp_verified, :id, :auth0_id, :kv_id, :created_at, :updated_at,
                                                  :province_id, :city_id, :district_id, :sub_district_id])
                  .merge(id: @backyard_user.id),
        }, status: :created

      # ! specific rescues removed (request from IT)
      # rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
      #   render json: {
      #     message: 'User creation failed.',
      #     data: e.record.errors
      #   }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      # rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      #   render json: {
      #     message: "account already exists",
      #     data: { email => ['has already been taken'] }
      #   }, status: :conflict
      # rescue Auth0RegistrationError => e
      #   render json: {
      #     message: e.custom_message,
      #     data: e.data
      #   }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      # rescue KvRegistrationError => e
      #   # if KV failed to register user, rollback auth0 user
      #   # TODO: add job & sidekiq (as of now it is overkill to add sidekiq )
      #   # TODO: add notification to slack/email if deletion failed
      #   Auth0::User::DeleteUserService.new(token: @sso_token, auth0_id: result_auth0_id).call if result_auth0_id.present?
      #   render json: {
      #     message: e.custom_message,
      #     data: e.data
      #   }, status: :unprocessable_entity

      rescue StandardError
        render json: {
          message: 'User creation failed.',
        }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      end

      # ! DEPCRECATED API
      def validate
        # get token
        @token = Auth0TokenCache.get_token

        email = validate_email(last_reset_params[:email])
        user = auth0_client.users_by_email(email).first
        backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)

        # exit if user not exists
        return render json: {}, status: :not_found if user.nil? || backyard_user.nil?

        response = {
          condition_did_reset: false,
          condition_migrated_user: false,
          condition_had_logged_in: false,
        }

        migration_date = Date.parse('2024-08-13') # hardcoded migration date

        response[:condition_did_reset] = user['last_password_reset'].present?
        response[:condition_had_logged_in] = user['last_login'].present?
        response[:condition_migrated_user] = backyard_user.createdat < migration_date

        # ternary
        response[:need_reset] = !response[:condition_did_reset] && response[:condition_migrated_user] && !response[:condition_had_logged_in]

        render json: response

      rescue InvalidEmailError => e
        render json: { error: e.message }, status: :bad_request
      rescue Auth0::BadRequest
        render json: { error: "Bad request" }, status: :bad_request
      rescue Auth0::Exception
        render json: { error: "An error occurred while processing your request" }, status: :internal_server_error
      end

      private
        def create_user_profile_params
          params.permit(:email, :name, :given_name, :family_name, :nickname, :picture,
                                      :birth_date, :phone_number, :country, :province, :city, :district, :address, :postal_code,
                                      :business_name, :business_email, :business_contact, :business_address, :business_category, :business_revenue,
                                      :source, :nik, :no_kk, :mothers_name, :npwp, :birth_place,
                                      :province_id, :city_id, :district_id, :sub_district_id)
        end

        def create_backyard_user_params
          params.permit(:name, :email, :phone_number, :source, :business_category)
        end

        def auth0_user_params
          params.require(:email)
          params.require(:password)
          params.require(:name)
          params.require(:given_name)
          params.require(:family_name)
          params.permit(:email, :password, :name, :given_name, :family_name, :nickname, :picture)
        end

        def user_profile_params
          params.require(:id_token)
          params.permit(:id_token)
        end

        def last_reset_params
          params.require(:email)
          params.permit(:email)
        end

        def validate_email(email)
          email = email.to_s.downcase
          email_regex = /\A[\w+\-.]+@[a-z\d-]+(\.[a-z\d-]+)*\.[a-z]+\z/i

          unless email.match?(email_regex)
            raise InvalidEmailError, "Invalid email format"
          end

          email
        end
    end
  end
end

class KvRegisterJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default

  def perform(user_id:)
    user_profile = UserProfile.find(user_id)
    kv_id = Kv::User::NewUserSetupService.new(user: user_profile).call

    user_profile.save!

    Rails.logger.info "successfully synchronized ktp document for KV customer ID #{kv_id}"
  end
end

class HttpService
  attr_accessor :response, :response_body

  def initialize(logging: true)
    @logging = logging
  end

  def base_url
    raise NotImplementedError
  end

  def relative_url
    raise NotImplementedError
  end

  def api_method
    raise NotImplementedError
  end

  def request_uuid
    SecureRandom.uuid.freeze
  end

  def body; end

  def headers; end

  def query; end

  def fire!
    client = Faraday.new(url: base_url, request: { timeout: 10 }) do |faraday|
      faraday.request :url_encoded
      faraday.response :logger, ::Logger.new(STDOUT), bodies: true if @logging
      faraday.adapter Faraday.default_adapter
    end

    @response = client.send(api_method.downcase.to_sym, relative_url) do |req|
      req.params = query if query.present?
      req.headers.merge!(headers) if headers.present?
      req.body = body if body.present?
    end

    process_response_body
  end

  def success?
    @response.status >= 200 and @response.status < 300
  end

  def process_response_body
    content_type = @response.headers['content-type']

    @response_body = if content_type&.include?('application/json')
      begin
        body = JSON.parse(@response.body)
        body.is_a?(Array) ? body.map(&:with_indifferent_access) : body.with_indifferent_access
      rescue JSON::ParserError
        @response.body
      end
    else
      # binary/other content types - return raw body
      @response.body.b
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'jwt'

module Api
  module V1
    class UsersController < ApiController
      before_action :authorize, except: [:validate, :create]
      before_action :authorize_session_db, except: [:validate, :create]

      AUTH0_SSO_TOKEN_CACHE_KEY = "auth0_token/sso_service_token"

      # example / test route
      def index
        @params = {
          q: "email:*",
          fields: 'email,user_id,name',
          include_fields: true,
          page: 0,
          per_page: 10
        }

        @users = auth0_client.users @params
        render json: @users
      end

      def get_profile # get profile from id_token
        # Store debug info for Lograge custom payload
        @debug_info = { action: 'get_profile', step: 'starting' }

        begin
          id_token = user_profile_params[:id_token]
          @debug_info[:id_token_present] = !id_token.blank?
          @debug_info[:id_token_length] = id_token&.length

          if id_token.blank?
            @debug_info[:error] = 'ID Token is missing'
            render json: { message: 'ID Token is required.' }, status: :bad_request
            return
          end

          # get token payload
          @debug_info[:step] = 'decoding_jwt'
          decoded = JWT.decode(id_token, nil, false, { algorithm: 'RS256' })
          @debug_info[:jwt_payload_keys] = decoded[0]&.keys

          email = decoded[0]['email']
          name = decoded[0]['name']
          @debug_info[:extracted_email] = email
          @debug_info[:extracted_name] = name&.present?

          if email.blank?
            @debug_info[:error] = 'Email not found in JWT token'
            render json: { message: 'Email not found in token.' }, status: :bad_request
            return
          end

          # > check if account is deleted
          @debug_info[:step] = 'checking_account_active'
          account_is_active_check(email)

          # get user profile
          @debug_info[:step] = 'looking_up_backyard_user'
          backyard_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email)
          @debug_info[:backyard_user_found] = !backyard_user.nil?

          if backyard_user.nil?
            @debug_info[:error] = 'BackyardUser not found'
            render json: {
              message: 'User profile not found.'
            }, status: :not_found
          else
            @debug_info[:step] = 'success'
            @debug_info[:user_id] = backyard_user.id
            @debug_info[:user_type] = backyard_user.usertype

            # legacy data (if call this endpoint success, then this must be true)
            # might still be used by wawasan or landing
            user_session = true

            response_data = {
              message: 'User profile retrieved successfully.',
              data: {
                id: backyard_user.id,
                email: backyard_user.email,
                name: name,
                user_type: backyard_user.usertype,
                session: user_session
              }
            }

            render json: response_data
          end

        rescue JWT::DecodeError => e
          @debug_info[:error] = "JWT Decode Error: #{e.message}"
          render json: { message: 'Invalid JWT token.' }, status: :unauthorized
        rescue StandardError => e
          @debug_info[:error] = "#{e.class}: #{e.message}"
          @debug_info[:backtrace] = e.backtrace.first(3)
          render json: { message: 'Internal server error.' }, status: :internal_server_error
        end
      end

      def create
        # > check all flagging headers
        async_kv = request.headers['x-async-kv'] == 'true'

require 'auth0'

module Api
  module V1
    class ProfilesController < ApiController
      before_action :authorize
      before_action :authorize_session_db
      before_action :decode_id_token, except: [:sync_document]
      before_action :account_is_active_check_from_id_token_hook, except: [:sync_document]

      def show
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)
        profile = user&.user_profile

        begin
          auth0_id = sub_from_id_token

          # find profile by auth0_id or email
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(auth0_id: auth0_id) if auth0_id
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(email: user.email) if profile.blank?
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          # add association if not exists
          profile.update!(backyard_user: user) if profile.backyard_user.blank?
          user.update!(user_profile: profile) if user.user_profile.blank?

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def update
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)

        begin
          profile = user.user_profile
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          if params[:ktp_document].present?
            profile.ktp_document.purge if profile.ktp_document.attached? # remove the old image if exists
            profile.ktp_document.attach(params[:ktp_document])
          end

          # only validate name fields if those fields are present in request
          profile.fields_to_validate = []
          [:name, :given_name, :family_name].each do |field|
            profile.fields_to_validate << field if params.key?(field.to_s)
          end

          profile.update!(profile_params)

          user.update!({
            fullname: profile_params['name'],
            contactno: profile_params['phone_number'],
            address: profile_params['address'],
            source: user.source # source cant be blank on update
          })

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          render json: { message: e.record.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def download_document
        user_id = params[:user_id]
        resource_id = params[:id]
        signature = params[:signature]
        expires_at = params[:expires_at].to_i

        # authorize
        attachment = ActiveStorage::Attachment.find(resource_id)
        profile = UserProfile.find(attachment.record_id)

        if profile.blank? || email_from_id_token != profile.email || profile.backyard_user.id != user_id
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        # validate the signed url
        unless LinkExpiration.valid_signed_url?(resource_id, signature, expires_at)
          return render json: { error: 'Invalid or expired download link' }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        # retrieve the blob
        blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find(attachment.blob_id)

        # serve the file
        send_data blob.download,
                  type: blob.content_type,
                  disposition: 'attachment',
                  filename: blob.filename.to_s
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
        render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
      end

        email = sync_document_params[:email]
        resource_url = sync_document_params[:resource_url]

                         'image/png'
                       when '.pdf'
                         'application/pdf'

        end

        get_document_service.call

        response_body = get_document_service.response_body.b

        profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(kv_id: kv_user_id)
        profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(email: email) if profile.blank?
        raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, 'profile not found' if profile.blank?

        profile.ktp_document.attach(
          io: StringIO.new(response_body),
          filename: filename,
          content_type: content_type
        )

        profile.save!

        render json: { message: 'document sync successful' }, status: :ok
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
        render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
      end

      private
        def profile_params
          params.permit(:name, :given_name, :family_name, :phone_number, :gender, :address,
                        :birth_date, :mothers_name, :nik, :no_kk, :business_category,
                        :ktp_document)
        end

        def sync_document_params
          params.permit(:user_id, :email, :resource_url)
        end

        def email_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('email', nil)
        end

        def sub_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('sub', nil)
        end
    end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'auth0'

module Api
  module V1
    class ProfilesController < ApiController
      before_action :authorize
      before_action :authorize_session_db
      before_action :decode_id_token
      before_action :account_is_active_check_from_id_token_hook

      def show
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)
        profile = user&.user_profile

        begin
          auth0_id = sub_from_id_token

          # find profile by auth0_id or email
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(auth0_id: auth0_id) if auth0_id
          profile ||= UserProfile.find_by(email: user.email) if profile.blank?
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          # add association if not exists
          profile.update!(backyard_user: user) if profile.backyard_user.blank?
          user.update!(user_profile: profile) if user.user_profile.blank?

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def update
        if email_from_id_token.blank?
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: email_from_id_token)

        begin
          profile = user.user_profile
          raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, "profile not found" if profile.blank?

          if params[:ktp_document].present?
            profile.ktp_document.purge if profile.ktp_document.attached? # remove the old image if exists
            profile.ktp_document.attach(params[:ktp_document])
          end

          # only validate name fields if those fields are present in request
          profile.fields_to_validate = []
          [:name, :given_name, :family_name].each do |field|
            profile.fields_to_validate << field if params.key?(field.to_s)
          end

          profile.update!(profile_params)

          user.update!({
            fullname: profile_params['name'],
            contactno: profile_params['phone_number'],
            address: profile_params['address'],
            source: user.source # source cant be blank on update
          })

          response = ProfileSerializer.new(profile)
          render json: response, status: :ok
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
          render json: { message: e.record.errors.full_messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
          render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def download_document
        user_id = params[:user_id]
        resource_id = params[:id]
        signature = params[:signature]
        expires_at = params[:expires_at].to_i

        # authorize
        attachment = ActiveStorage::Attachment.find(resource_id)
        profile = UserProfile.find(attachment.record_id)

        if profile.blank? || email_from_id_token != profile.email || profile.backyard_user.id != user_id
          render json: { message: 'bad credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        # validate the signed url
        unless LinkExpiration.valid_signed_url?(resource_id, signature, expires_at)
          return render json: { error: 'Invalid or expired download link' }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        # retrieve the blob
        blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find(attachment.blob_id)

        # serve the file
        send_data blob.download,
                  type: blob.content_type,
                  disposition: 'attachment',
                  filename: blob.filename.to_s
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound => e
        Rails.logger.error "Failed to get profile: #{e.message}"
        render json: { message: e.message }, status: :not_found
      end

      private
        def profile_params
          params.permit(:name, :given_name, :family_name, :phone_number, :gender, :address,
                        :birth_date, :mothers_name, :nik, :no_kk, :business_category,
                        :ktp_document)
        end

        def sync_document_params
          params.permit(:user_id, :email, :resource_url)
        end

        def email_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('email', nil)
        end

        def sub_from_id_token
          @decoded_id_token&.token&.first&.fetch('sub', nil)
        end
    end
  end
end

.uat-variables: &uat-variables
  KUBECONFIG: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.kube/config
  GCLOUD_PROJECT: advisoryhub-ic1-uat-sk7g
  CLOUDSDK_COMPUTE_ZONE: asia-southeast2-a
  CLOUDSDK_CONTAINER_CLUSTER: gke-cl1-ic1-ah-uat
  TILLERLESS: "true"
  TILLER_NAMESPACE: default
  USE_GKE_GCLOUD_AUTH_PLUGIN: "true"
  GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/gcp-key.json
  KUBE_CONFIG_PATH: $CI_PROJECT_DIR/.kube/config

.uat-mr-rules: &uat-mr-rules
  services:
  - name: mysql:8.0
    alias: mysql
    command: ["--default-authentication-plugin=mysql_native_password"]
  variables:
    RAILS_ENV: test
    MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: root

    # tests env vars
    DATABASE_HOST: "mysql"
    DATABASE_PORT: 3306
    DATABASE_USERNAME: "root"
    DATABASE_PASSWORD: "root"
    DB_TEST: "googleindosat_test"
    DATABASE_URL: "mysql2://root:root@mysql:3306/googleindosat_test"
    DATABASE_CLEANER_ALLOW_REMOTE_DATABASE_URL: "true"

    GCP_CREDENTIALS_PATH: 'x'
    GCP_BUCKET: 'x'
    RAILS_SERVE_STATIC_FILES: enabled
    KLOUDVILLE_ENDPOINT: 'https://marketplacedev.gammasprint.com/'
    KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN_EXPIRE: 3600
    KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN_SECRET: "umqpz8PgMtAwZJFRng3Yoe1dKF6pX8G9fBVBIBmB5xBIyOSU02b3YrISSrKlfNt"
    KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN: "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJCdXNpbmVzczphZHZpc29yeWh1Yi5zeXN0ZW0iLCJpcCI6IioiLCJ2YWxpZEZyb20iOjE2NTkyODY4MDAsImp0aSI6IjdiNjdhNTJhLTliMmMtNGE5ZC1iYmRlLTYxNTA2ZTY5MzZjMSJ9.IvN3XTS4xYT9vW2zo02QR5EMxfVdVP0PV0cx4cuDets"
    AUTH0_SSO_APP_CLIENT_ID: k9Z2qXA230fBMMVDdnxdapGgkGBjcCfL
    AUTH0_DEFAULT_USER_STORE: Username-Password-Authentication
    AUTH0_DOMAIN: dev-f42nu1kp3uwdld5f.us.auth0.com
    AUTH0_URI: https://dev-f42nu1kp3uwdld5f.us.auth0.com/
    AUTH0_MANAGEMENT_AUDIENCE_URI: https://dev-f42nu1kp3uwdld5f.us.auth0.com/api/v2/
    ENCRYPTION_KEY: "0kxVaetzFnPHsLZ9V2BAqQAmr8We3ybycs6HLxebgG4="
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event'

# optimized full environment setup
.full-env-before-script: &full-env-before-script
  before_script:
    # Install system dependencies in one layer
    - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends default-mysql-client libmariadb-dev curl gnupg build-essential

    # Install bundler and gems, relying on BUNDLE_* environment variables 
    - gem install bundler --no-document
    - bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3 

# optimized static analysis setup
.static-analysis-before-script: &static-analysis-before-script
  before_script:
    - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential libmariadb-dev
    - gem install bundler --no-document
    - bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle'
    - bundle config set --local without 'development'
    - bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

.uat-master-push-rules: &uat-master-push-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == 'main'

.uat-approved-rules: &uat-approved-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event' && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_APPROVED

.uat-env: &uat-env
  environment:
    name: uat

code-quality:
  extends: .base_job
  stage: unit-test
  script:
    # mysql healthcheck with better timeout
    - |
      MAX_TRIES=15
      COUNTER=0
      echo "Waiting for MySQL to be ready..."
      until mysql -h mysql -u root -proot -e "SELECT 1" &>/dev/null; do
        sleep 1
        COUNTER=$((COUNTER+1))
        if [ $COUNTER -gt $MAX_TRIES ]; then
          echo "Failed to connect to MySQL after 15 seconds"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Still waiting for MySQL... ($COUNTER/$MAX_TRIES)"
      done

    # create db for normal rspec
    - echo "MySQL is up - verifying database operations"
    - bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load

    # rubocop with caching
    - echo "Running static analysis with Rubocop"
    - bundle exec rubocop --format progress --format offenses --out rubocop.txt
    
    # rails best practices
    - echo "Running static analysis with Rails best practice"
    - bundle exec rails_best_practices -e "vendor,db/migrate" . > rails_bp.txt || true

    - echo "Running code analysis with Brakeman"
    - gem install brakeman --no-document
    - bundle exec brakeman -q --no-exit-on-warn --format json --output brakeman.json .

    # run rspec with parallel execution
    - bundle exec rspec --format progress --format RspecJunitFormatter --out rspec.xml --format ParallelTests::RSpec::RuntimeLogger --out tmp/parallel_runtime_rspec.log
  <<: *uat-mr-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  <<: *full-env-before-script
  allow_failure: false
  retry: 2
  tags:
    - kaniko
  artifacts:
    reports:
      junit: rspec.xml
    paths:
      - coverage/
    expire_in: 1 week

# Docker Build Stage - optimized
uat-docker-build:
  image: docker:24.0.7
  stage: docker-build
  services:
    - name: docker:20.10-dind
      command: ["dockerd", "--host=tcp://0.0.0.0:2375", "--mtu=1460"]
  variables:
    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2375
    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: ""
    DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:
    # slack notif
    - |
      curl -v -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --connect-timeout 10 \
        --max-time 30 \
        --retry 3 \
        --retry-delay 2 \
        --retry-connrefused \
        --data "{\"text\":\":building_construction: *UAT Docker Build Starting*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    # check docker service status with better timeout
    - echo "Checking Docker daemon status..."
    - for i in $(seq 1 15); do docker info > /dev/null 2>&1 && break || (echo "Waiting for Docker daemon to start... ($i/15)" && sleep 1); done
    - docker info || (echo "Docker daemon failed to start" && exit 1)

    # setup buildx
    - docker buildx create --use --name mybuilder
    - docker buildx inspect --bootstrap

    # install gcloud CLI (Alpine method)
    - apk add --no-cache bash curl python3 py3-pip
    - curl -sSL https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash
    - export PATH="$PATH:/root/google-cloud-sdk/bin"

    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_UAT" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_UAT --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_UAT --internal-ip
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev
  script:

    # build and push image with BuildKit optimizations
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    - echo "Building and pushing UAT Image"
    - |
      for i in 1 2 3; do
        echo "Build attempt $i/3"
        if docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg RAILS_ENV=staging --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 -t asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev/advisoryhub-ic1-uat-sk7g/ioh/sso/staging:$COMMIT_HASH --push -f ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/Dockerfile ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}; then
          echo "Build successful on attempt $i"
          break
        else
          echo "Build failed on attempt $i"
          if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "All build attempts failed"
            exit 1
          fi
          sleep 30
        fi
      done
  after_script:
    # slack notification - docker build completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *UAT Docker Build Completed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *UAT Docker Build Failed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *uat-master-push-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  allow_failure: false
  retry: 2
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker

# Deploy Stage - optimized
uat-deploy:
  image: google/cloud-sdk:alpine
  stage: deploy
  variables:
    <<: *uat-variables
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-helm-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /usr/bin/helm
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:    
    # construct commit hash first
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    
    # slack notification - deployment starting
    - |
      curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --data "{\"text\":\":rocket: *UAT Deployment to Kubernetes Starting*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* $COMMIT_HASH\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_UAT" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud components install gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_UAT --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_UAT --internal-ip
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev

    # install helm
    - apk add --no-cache helm

    # setup helm rails-service repo
    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Deploying Helm"
    - |
      helm upgrade --install --debug ioh-ide-sso helm-rails/rails-service --version 0.5.1 --namespace default \
        --set image.tag=$COMMIT_HASH \
        --set externalSecrets.enabled=true \
        --set-file config.env.content=deployment/.env.uat.vars \
        --set dbMigrate.enabled=true \
        --set sidekiqWorker.enabled=true \
        -f deployment/uat-values.yaml \
        --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH
  after_script:
    # slack notification - deployment completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *UAT Deployment Completed Successfully*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *UAT Deployment Failed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *uat-master-push-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker
  needs:
    - uat-docker-build

# optimized full environment setup
.full-env-before-script: &full-env-before-script
  before_script:
    # Install system dependencies in one layer
    - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends default-mysql-client libmariadb-dev curl gnupg build-essential

    # Install bundler and gems, relying on BUNDLE_* environment variables 
    - gem install bundler --no-document
    - bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3 

# optimized static analysis setup
.static-analysis-before-script: &static-analysis-before-script
  before_script:
    - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential libmariadb-dev
    - gem install bundler --no-document
    - bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle'
    - bundle config set --local without 'development'
    - bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3

.uat-master-push-rules: &uat-master-push-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == 'main'

.uat-approved-rules: &uat-approved-rules
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == 'merge_request_event' && $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_APPROVED

.uat-env: &uat-env
  environment:
    name: uat

code-quality:
  extends: .base_job
  stage: unit-test
  script:
    # mysql healthcheck with better timeout
    - |
      MAX_TRIES=15
      COUNTER=0
      echo "Waiting for MySQL to be ready..."
      until mysql -h mysql -u root -proot -e "SELECT 1" &>/dev/null; do
        sleep 1
        COUNTER=$((COUNTER+1))
        if [ $COUNTER -gt $MAX_TRIES ]; then
          echo "Failed to connect to MySQL after 15 seconds"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Still waiting for MySQL... ($COUNTER/$MAX_TRIES)"
      done

    # create db for normal rspec
    - echo "MySQL is up - verifying database operations"
    - bundle exec rails db:create db:schema:load

    # rubocop with caching
    - echo "Running static analysis with Rubocop"
    - bundle exec rubocop --format progress --format offenses --out rubocop.txt
    
    # rails best practices
    - echo "Running static analysis with Rails best practice"
    - bundle exec rails_best_practices -e "vendor,db/migrate" . > rails_bp.txt || true

    - echo "Running code analysis with Brakeman"
    - gem install brakeman --no-document
    - bundle exec brakeman -q --no-exit-on-warn --format json --output brakeman.json .

    # run rspec with parallel execution
    - bundle exec rspec --format progress --format RspecJunitFormatter --out rspec.xml --format ParallelTests::RSpec::RuntimeLogger --out tmp/parallel_runtime_rspec.log
  <<: *uat-mr-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  <<: *full-env-before-script
  allow_failure: false
  retry: 2
  tags:
    - kaniko
  artifacts:
    reports:
      junit: rspec.xml
    paths:
      - coverage/
    expire_in: 1 week

# Docker Build Stage - optimized
uat-docker-build:
  image: docker:24.0.7
  stage: docker-build
  services:
    - name: docker:20.10-dind
      command: ["dockerd", "--host=tcp://0.0.0.0:2375", "--mtu=1460"]
  variables:
    DOCKER_HOST: tcp://docker:2375
    DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR: ""
    DOCKER_BUILDKIT: "1"
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:
    # slack notif
    - |
      curl -v -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --connect-timeout 10 \
        --max-time 30 \
        --retry 3 \
        --retry-delay 2 \
        --retry-connrefused \
        --data "{\"text\":\":building_construction: *UAT Docker Build Starting*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    # check docker service status with better timeout
    - echo "Checking Docker daemon status..."
    - for i in $(seq 1 15); do docker info > /dev/null 2>&1 && break || (echo "Waiting for Docker daemon to start... ($i/15)" && sleep 1); done
    - docker info || (echo "Docker daemon failed to start" && exit 1)

    # setup buildx
    - docker buildx create --use --name mybuilder
    - docker buildx inspect --bootstrap

    # install gcloud CLI (Alpine method)
    - apk add --no-cache bash curl python3 py3-pip
    - curl -sSL https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash
    - export PATH="$PATH:/root/google-cloud-sdk/bin"

    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_UAT" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_UAT --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_UAT --internal-ip
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev
  script:

    # build and push image with BuildKit optimizations
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    - echo "Building and pushing UAT Image"
    - |
      for i in 1 2 3; do
        echo "Build attempt $i/3"
        if docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg RAILS_ENV=staging --build-arg BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=1 -t asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev/advisoryhub-ic1-uat-sk7g/ioh/sso/staging:$COMMIT_HASH --push -f ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/Dockerfile ${CI_PROJECT_DIR}; then
          echo "Build successful on attempt $i"
          break
        else
          echo "Build failed on attempt $i"
          if [ $i -eq 3 ]; then
            echo "All build attempts failed"
            exit 1
          fi
          sleep 30
        fi
      done
  after_script:
    # slack notification - docker build completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *UAT Docker Build Completed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *UAT Docker Build Failed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *uat-master-push-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  allow_failure: false
  retry: 2
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker

# Deploy Stage - optimized
uat-deploy:
  image: google/cloud-sdk:alpine
  stage: deploy
  variables:
    <<: *uat-variables
  cache:
    key: "gcloud-kubectl-helm-cache-v1"
    paths:
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/kubectl
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/bin/gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
      - /usr/lib/google-cloud-sdk/platform/bundledpythonunix/
      - /usr/bin/helm
      - /var/cache/apk/
    policy: pull-push
    when: always
  before_script:    
    # construct commit hash first
    - export COMMIT_HASH=${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}
    
    # slack notification - deployment starting
    - |
      curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
        --data "{\"text\":\":rocket: *UAT Deployment to Kubernetes Starting*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* $COMMIT_HASH\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
        $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack notification failed"

    # gcloud setup
    - echo "$GCP_SA_KEY_UAT" | base64 -d > gcp-key.json
    - gcloud auth activate-service-account --key-file=gcp-key.json
    - gcloud components install gke-gcloud-auth-plugin
    - gcloud container clusters get-credentials $GKE_CLUSTER_NAME_UAT --zone $GKE_ZONE --project $GKE_PROJECT_ID_UAT --internal-ip
    - gcloud auth configure-docker asia-southeast2-docker.pkg.dev

    # install helm
    - apk add --no-cache helm

    # setup helm rails-service repo
    - helm repo add --username helm-rails --password $GITLAB_DEPLOY_TOKEN_PASSWORD helm-rails http://mygitlab-dev.ioh.co.id/api/v4/projects/61/packages/helm/stable
    - helm repo update
  script:
    - echo "Deploying Helm"
    - |
      helm upgrade --install --debug ioh-ide-sso helm-rails/rails-service --version 0.5.1 --namespace default \
        --set image.tag=$COMMIT_HASH \
        --set externalSecrets.enabled=true \
        --set-file config.env.content=deployment/.env.uat.vars \
        --set dbMigrate.enabled=true \
        --set sidekiqWorker.enabled=true \
        -f deployment/uat-values.yaml \
        --kubeconfig $KUBE_CONFIG_PATH
  after_script:
    # slack notification - deployment completed/failed
    - |
      if [ "$CI_JOB_STATUS" = "success" ]; then
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":white_check_mark: *UAT Deployment Completed Successfully*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack success notification failed"
      else
        curl -X POST -H 'Content-type: application/json' \
          --data "{\"text\":\":x: *UAT Deployment Failed*\n:package: *Project:* $CI_PROJECT_NAME\n:branch: *Branch:* $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\n:hash: *Commit:* ${CI_COMMIT_SHA:0:7}\n:memo: *Message:* $CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE\n:bust_in_silhouette: *Author:* $CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR\n:link: *Pipeline:* $CI_PIPELINE_URL\"}" \
          $SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL_DEPLOYMENT || echo "Slack failure notification failed"
      fi
  <<: *uat-master-push-rules
  <<: *uat-env
  allow_failure: false
  tags:
    - docker-in-docker
  needs:
    - uat-docker-build

# frozen_string_literal: true

require 'sidekiq/web'

Rails.application.routes.draw do
  # Define your application routes per the DSL in https://guides.rubyonrails.org/routing.html

  # Reveal health status on /up that returns 200 if the app boots with no exceptions, otherwise 500.
  # Can be used by load balancers and uptime monitors to verify that the app is live.

  if ENV["RAILS_ENV"] == "staging"
    mount Rswag::Ui::Engine => 'sso/api-docs'
    mount Rswag::Api::Engine => 'sso/api-docs'
  end

  scope :sso do
    get 'health', to: 'health#health'
    get '/', to: 'health#health'

    namespace :api, defaults: { format: :json } do
      namespace :v1 do
        post 'users/profile', to: 'users#get_profile' # marked for deletion, moved to new profile management api
        post 'users/change_password', to: 'accounts#change_password'
        post 'users/set_password', to: 'accounts#set_password'
        # post 'users/change_password/link', to: 'accounts#change_password_link' # uncomment if needed

        delete 'users/delete', to: 'accounts#deactivate' # actual only soft delete

        # ! DEPCRECATED API
        # get 'users/last_reset', to: 'users#validate'
        # post 'users/validate', to: 'users#validate' # server-to-server only

        resources :users, only: [:create] do
          # profile management api
          resource :profile do
            get 'identity_documents/:id', action: :download_document, as: 'identity_document'

            # sync ktp document from bulk portal AJ callback
            post 'sync_document', action: :sync_document
          end
        end

        get 'profiles', to: 'profiles#show'
        put 'profiles', to: 'profiles#update'

        # authentication routes (for client credentials grant)
        post 'oauth/token', to: 'oauth#token'
        post 'oauth/token/exchange', to: 'oauth#exchange_code_for_token'
        post 'oauth/token/revoke', to: 'oauth#revoke_token'
        post 'oauth/token/kv', to: 'oauth#token_kv'
        post 'oauth/token/kv/verify', to: 'oauth#token_kv_verify'
        post 'oauth/mfa/authenticator-challenge', to: 'oauth#mfa_authenticator_challenge'
        post 'oauth/mfa/verify', to: 'oauth#mfa_verify'
      end
    end
  end

  Sidekiq::Web.use Rack::Auth::Basic  do |username, password|
    ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(username), ::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(ENV["SIDEKIQ_USERNAME"])) &
      ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(password), ::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(ENV["SIDEKIQ_PASSWORD"]))
  end
  mount Sidekiq::Web => '/sso/sidekiq'
end

        allow(mock_kv_service).to receive(:call).and_return('kv_user_id')
      end

      it 'returns a created user' do
        expect {
          post '/sso/api/v1/users', params: user_params, headers: {}
        }.to change(BackyardUser, :count).by(1)
          .and change(UserProfile, :count).by(1)

        created_user = BackyardUser.find_by(email: user_params[:email])
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:created)

        # created records
        expect(created_user.email).to eq(user_params[:email])
        expect(created_user.user_profile.email).to eq(user_params[:email])

        expect(json['message']).to eq('User created successfully.')
        expect(json['data']['id']).to eq(created_user.id)
        expect(json['data']['email']).to eq(user_params[:email])
        expect(json['data']['name']).to eq(user_params[:name])
      end
    end

    context 'when user data is duplicate on KV' do
      before do
        # mock auth0 create user service
        mock_auth0_service = instance_double(Auth0::CreateUserService)
        allow(Auth0::CreateUserService).to receive(:new).and_return(mock_auth0_service)
        allow(mock_auth0_service).to receive(:call).and_return('auth0|auth0_user_id')

        # mock KV registration service
        mock_service = instance_double(Kv::User::UserRegistrationService)
        allow(Kv::User::UserRegistrationService).to receive(:new).and_return(mock_service)
        allow(mock_service).to receive(:call)
        allow(mock_service).to receive(:success?).and_return(false)
        allow(mock_service).to receive(:response_body).and_return({
          message: {
            code: 'CUST_ERR_0049',
            text: 'Account with matching information already registered'
          }
        })

        post '/sso/api/v1/users', params: user_params, headers: {}
