require 'rails_helper'
RSpec.describe Api::V1::ProfilesController, type: :request do
  let(:user) { create(:backyard_user) }
  let!(:user_without_profile) { create(:backyard_user) }
  let!(:user_profile) { create(:user_profile, backyard_user: user) }
  let(:validation_response) { double('ValidationResponse', decoded_token: Auth0Token::Token.new([{ 'scope' => 'read:profile' }]), error: nil) }
  let(:id_token_validation_response) { double('IdTokenValidationResponse', decoded_token: 'decoded_id_token', error: nil) }
  let(:auth0_id_token) do
    double(
      token: [
        {
          'sub' => 'auth0|aabbcasdasdcdd',
          'email' => user.email,
        }
      ]
    )
  end
  # add auth0 session
  let!(:auth0_session) { create(:auth0_session, access_token: 'valid_token') }

  before do
    allow_any_instance_of(Api::V1::ProfilesController).to receive(:email_from_id_token).and_return(user.email)
    allow_any_instance_of(Api::V1::ProfilesController).to receive(:sub_from_id_token).and_return(nil)
    allow(Auth0Token).to receive(:validate_token).and_return(validation_response)
    allow(Auth0Token).to receive(:validate_token_without_audience).and_return(id_token_validation_response)
    allow(JWT).to receive(:decode).and_return([
      'email' => user.email,
      'name' => user.fullname
    ])
    allow(Jwt).to receive(:decode_id_token).and_return(auth0_id_token)
  end

  describe 'GET #show' do
    context 'when user is authorized and session exists' do
      before do
        get "/sso/api/v1/profiles", headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns success status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end

      it 'returns the user profile data' do
        expect(json['data']['id']).to eq(user.id)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['email']).to eq(user.email)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['name']).to eq(user.fullname)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['nationality']).to eq('ID')
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['phone_number']).to eq(user.user_profile.phone_number)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['gender']).to eq(user.user_profile.gender)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['address']).to eq(user.user_profile.address)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['birth_date']).to eq(user.user_profile.birth_date.to_s)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['mothers_maiden_name']).to eq(user.user_profile.mothers_name)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['nik']).to eq(user.user_profile.nik)
        expect(json['data']['attributes']['business_category']).to eq(user.user_profile.business_category)
      end
    end

    context 'when session does not exist' do
      before do
        get "/sso/api/v1/profiles", headers: authenticated_header('invalid_token')
      end

      it 'returns unauthorized status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unauthorized)
      end

      it 'returns appropriate error message' do
        expect(json['message']).to eq('Bad credentials')
      end
    end

    context 'when user is not authorized' do
      it 'returns unauthorized status' do
        allow_any_instance_of(Api::V1::ProfilesController).to receive(:email_from_id_token).and_return(nil)
        get "/sso/api/v1/profiles", headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:unauthorized)
      end
    end

    context 'when profile does not exist' do
      before do
        allow_any_instance_of(Api::V1::ProfilesController).to receive(:email_from_id_token).and_return(user_without_profile.email)
        get "/sso/api/v1/profiles", headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns not found status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
      end

      it 'returns appropriate error message' do
        expect(json['message']).to eq('profile not found')
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'PUT #update' do
    let(:valid_params) do
      {
        name: 'test user updated',
        phone_number: '1234567890',
        address: '123 Test St'
      }
    end

    context 'when user is authorized and profile exists' do
      before do
        put "/sso/api/v1/profiles",
            params: valid_params,
            headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns success status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end

      it 'updates the profile' do
        user_profile.reload
        expect(user_profile.phone_number).to eq('1234567890')
        expect(user_profile.address).to eq('123 Test St')
      end
    end

    context 'when profile does not exist' do
      before do
        allow_any_instance_of(Api::V1::ProfilesController).to receive(:email_from_id_token).and_return(user_without_profile.email)
        put "/sso/api/v1/profiles",
            params: valid_params,
            headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns not found status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
      end
    end
  end

  describe 'POST #sync_document' do
    let(:kv_user_id) { '123' }
    let(:resource_url) { 'http://example.com/document.jpg' }
    let(:get_document_service) { instance_double(Kv::User::GetDocumentService) }
    let(:document_content) { 'fake_binary_content' }

    before do
      allow(Kv::User::GetDocumentService).to receive(:new)
        .with(resource_url: resource_url)
        .and_return(get_document_service)
      allow(get_document_service).to receive(:call)
      allow(get_document_service).to receive(:response_body).and_return(document_content)
    end

    context 'when profile exists with kv_id' do
      before do
        user_profile.update!(kv_id: kv_user_id)
        post "/sso/api/v1/users/#{kv_user_id}/profile/sync_document",
             params: { resource_url: resource_url, email: user.email },
             headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns success status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end

      it 'attaches the document to the profile' do
        user_profile.reload
        expect(user_profile.ktp_document).to be_attached
      end

      it 'returns success message' do
        expect(json['message']).to eq('document sync successful')
      end
    end

    context 'when profile exists with email' do
      before do
        post "/sso/api/v1/users/#{kv_user_id}/profile/sync_document",
             params: { resource_url: resource_url, email: user.email },
             headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns success status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
      end

      it 'attaches the document to the profile' do
        user_profile.reload
        expect(user_profile.ktp_document).to be_attached
      end
    end

    context 'when profile does not exist' do
      before do
        post "/sso/api/v1/users/#{kv_user_id}/profile/sync_document",
             params: { resource_url: resource_url, email: 'nonexistent@example.com' },
             headers: authenticated_header(auth0_session.access_token)
      end

      it 'returns not found status' do
        expect(response).to have_http_status(:not_found)
      end

      it 'returns appropriate error message' do
        expect(json['message']).to eq('profile not found')
      end
    end
  end
end

namespace :dev do
  task profile_check_attachment: :environment do
    profile = UserProfile.find(0)

    if profile.ktp_document.attached?
      puts "Filename: #{profile.ktp_document.filename}"
      puts "Content Type: #{profile.ktp_document.content_type}"
      puts "File Size: #{profile.ktp_document.byte_size} bytes"

      File.open(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'dev_ktp_test.jpg'), 'wb') do |file|
        file.write(profile.ktp_document.download)
      end
      puts "Document downloaded to tmp/dev_ktp_test.jpg"
    else
      puts "No document attached"
    end
  end

  task profile_get_doc_from_kv: :environment do
    resource_url = 'dbresource/CUSTOMER/5d92217f-e569-4c6f-beae-7b8cb3d1b565/6088026730343312/IMG-20231215-WA0012.jpg'

    filename = File.basename(resource_url)
    content_type = case File.extname(filename).downcase
                   when '.jpg', '.jpeg'
                     'image/jpeg'
                   when '.png'
                     'image/png'
                   when '.pdf'
                     'application/pdf'
                   else
                     'image/jpeg'
    end

    get_document_service = Kv::User::GetDocumentService.new(
      resource_url: resource_url
    )

    get_document_service.call

    response_body = get_document_service.response_body.b

    profile = UserProfile.find(0)
    profile.ktp_document.attach(
      io: StringIO.new(response_body),
      filename: filename,
      content_type: content_type
    )

    profile.save!

    puts "Document attached successfully"

    puts "Content Type: #{content_type}"

Excellent! All KLOUDVILLE_ENDPOINT and related Kloudville (KV) integration code has been successfully removed from the ide-sso service. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary of Changes

### **Deleted Files:**
- `app/services/kv/user/user_registration_service.rb` - KV customer registration
- `app/services/kv/user/grant_portal_access_service.rb` - KV portal access
- `app/services/kv/user/get_document_service.rb` - KV document fetching
- `app/services/kv/user/new_user_setup_service.rb` - KV user setup orchestration
- `app/jobs/kv_register_job.rb` - Background job for async KV registration
- `lib/kv_token.rb` - JWT token handling for KV

### **Updated Controllers:**
- [users_controller.rb](app/controllers/api/v1/users_controller.rb) - Removed KV registration logic from `create` action
- [profiles_controller.rb](app/controllers/api/v1/profiles_controller.rb) - Removed `sync_document` action

### **Environment Configuration Files Cleaned:**
Removed `KLOUDVILLE_ENDPOINT`, `KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN`, `KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN_SECRET`, `KLOUDVILLE_TOKEN_EXPIRE` from:
- `deploy/.env.vars`, `deploy/.env.uat.vars`, `deploy/.env.production.vars`
- `deploy/.env.keys`
- `deploy/.secret.vars`, `deploy/.secret.uat.vars`, `deploy/.secret.production.vars`, `deploy/.secret.keys`
- `deployment/.env.uat.vars`, `deployment/.env.production.vars`
- `deployment/.secret.production.vars`
- `deployment/uat-values.yaml`, `deployment/prod-values.yaml`

### **CI/CD Pipelines Updated:**
- `.gitlab/uat-pipeline.yml` - Removed KV environment variables
- `.circleci/config.yml` - Removed KV environment variables

### **Routes Updated:**
- [config/routes.rb](config/routes.rb:39) - Removed `sync_document` route

### **Tests Updated:**
- [user_controller_spec.rb](spec/controllers/api/v1/user_controller_spec.rb) - Removed KV service mocks and duplicate KV test context
- [profiles_controller_spec.rb](spec/controllers/api/v1/profiles_controller_spec.rb) - Removed entire `sync_document` test suite

### **Development Tasks:**
- [lib/tasks/dev.rake](lib/tasks/dev.rake) - Removed `profile_get_doc_from_kv` task

The user registration flow now only creates Auth0 users and BackyardUsers, skipping KV registration entirely. The `kv_id` field remains in the UserProfile model for backwards compatibility with existing data.
